text:
sasha: Quick thread - I prototyped a "compact groups" left rail and hit a flaky deep-link handshake. sharing notes.

sasha: Symptom: deep links to child routes expand the group but the visual selection lands on the group header. URL is correct. example: /org/acme/ws/phoenix/reports/2026/summary

ben: Repro'd. Resolver is prefix-greedy. it matches /reports before the paramized child.

ravi: Proposal: resolution order should be: exact fullPath -> paramized match (pattern-aware) -> alias/legacy map -> longest-prefix fallback. ensures leaf routes win.

sasha: Pseudocode:
```
if (navIndex[fullPath]) return navIndex[fullPath];
if (paramMap.match(fullPath)) return paramMap[fullPath];
if (aliasMap[fullPath]) return aliasMap[fullPath];
return longestPrefixMatch(fullPath);
```

tam: Accessibility: when resolving to a child we need to 1) set aria-current="page" on the item, 2) move DOM focus to it, 3) if group was collapsed, set aria-expanded="true" on group button and announce expansion via a short live region. ensure the live region message and focus change are ordered so screen readers hear both.

ben: UX note: when we fall back (resolved != requested) show a light inline banner: "Showing closest match. Open original" (link). Dismissible, non-modal. Only surface it if user has access to requested route.

ravi: History behavior: canonicalize via replaceState to resolved path so sharing is stable. but preserve back-button semantics for users who opened the original external link. option: push ephemeral orig entry then replace to canonical so Back returns to origin.

sasha: Example flow:
```
const orig = normalize(location.href);
const resolved = resolve(orig);
if (resolved !== orig) {
  history.pushState({orig}, '', orig); // allow back -> external
  history.replaceState({}, '', resolved); // canonical in bar
  showBannerOnce(orig);
}
```

tam: Banner a11y: role="status" + aria-live="polite" and id the banner so the CTA link has aria-describedby. store dismissal in sessionStorage keyed by orig to avoid repeat nags.

ben: Dev question: where to keep aliasMap? prefer nav manifest in UI repo (source controlled) with runtime patch support via feature flags. keeps behaviour auditable.

ravi: Edge cases: slug collisions where group slug == child id (e.g., /overview). resolver should prefer exact param match when segment count and pattern align. add unit tests and telemetry when collisions happen so we can clean manifest.

sasha: Normalization rules: strip hash anchors -> trim trailing slashes -> decode percent-encoding -> stable-sort query keys except auth/utm. Also map hash anchors to ?anchor= for server logs.

tam: Keyboard flows: hotkey to focus nav should land on the highlighted item. if the highlight appears after expansion, apply a subtle fade to reduce jarring. ensure animations are short and disabled for reduced-motion users.

ben: Analytics: track resolved_from, resolved_to, banner_shown, banner_clicked so PM can see how often original pages are desired vs resolved.

sasha: Action items: @ben update resolver PR with exact->param->alias->prefix + collision tests; @ravi prototype push+replace history variant and demo popstate behavior; @tam write small a11y snippets (aria-current, aria-expanded, live region) and paste here; sasha will upload two mock frames (group-highlight vs resolved-highlight).

nav-bot: Preview build: https://console-preview.redwood/nav/compact-handshake (ephemeral)

ben: I'll also add a short unit test for trailing-slash and hash-anchor normalization.

ravi: I'll demo history/popstate edgecases in tomorrow's sync.

tam: I'll paste ARIA code in a follow-up message so eng can copy/paste.

sasha: Thanks all :thumbsup: meet 09:30 tomorrow to validate with QE and PMs.
